Class Individual

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Individual
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AgentView, IndividualCoreTraitsBridge, IndividualLotsBridge, IndividualWavesBridge
Direct Known Subclasses:
Symbiont
public class Individual extends Object implements Serializable, AgentView, IndividualLotsBridge, IndividualWavesBridge, IndividualCoreTraitsBridge
Canonical Domain Entity representing an individual eusocial insect in the simulation. Implements AgentView for direct bridge and inter-compatibility with the ECS and Rendering engines.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
